name: Buff名称
desc: Buff效果描述

name: Primeape
desc: Basic Attack damage dealt by the Pokemon increases by 15%.

name: Conkeldurr
desc: When the Pokemon uses a Basic Attack, Crit Rate increases by 10% for 2 rounds.

name: Hitmonlee
desc: After the Pokemon uses a Basic Attack, Crit Damage increases by 15% for 2 rounds.

name: Hitmonchan
desc: After the Pokemon uses a Basic Attack, dual ATK increases by 10% for 2 rounds.

name: Hitmontop
desc: After the Pokemon uses a Basic Attack, dual DEF increases by 20% for 2 rounds.

name: Urshifu
desc: During a single major round, each Basic Attack increases damage by 10% (stacks up to 3 times).

name: Sirfetch'd
desc: If the Pokemon did not use an active Basic Attack skill this round, its next Basic Attack deals 16% more damage (stacks up to 2 times).

name: Mienshao
desc: Basic Attack damage splashes to a random adjacent target for damage equal to 40% of the original damage.

name: Lucario
desc: Each Basic Attack grants a shield equal to 10% of Max HP (up to 3 triggers per Pokemon per major round).

name: Keldeo
desc: When using a Basic Attack, there is a 50% chance to restore HP equal to 30% of the damage dealt by that Basic Attack.

name: Gallade
desc: After the Pokemon uses an Ultimate, it additionally triggers 【Pursuit I】.

name: Koraidon
desc: After each active attack, the Pokemon can trigger 【Combo I】 once, with a 50% chance to additionally trigger 【Pursuit I】 1 extra time; if it defeats a unit, it can additionally trigger 【Pursuit I】 on a random target.

name: Pikachu
desc: Ultimate damage increases by 20%.

name: Raichu
desc: Rage Recovery Speed increases by 40%.

name: Luxray
desc: When the Pokemon uses an Ultimate, Crit Rate increases by 25%.

name: Pachirisu
desc: After the Pokemon uses an Ultimate, its next attack deals 100% more damage.

name: Emolga
desc: After the Pokemon uses an Ultimate, restore HP equal to 10% of Max HP.

name: Electivire
desc: Each time the Pokemon uses an Ultimate, Ultimate Damage Bonus increases by 12% (stacks up to 3 times).

name: Zapdos
desc: After using an Ultimate, Rage Recovery Speed increases by 50% for the next 2 rounds.

name: Ampharos
desc: On defeating an enemy, gain 100 extra Rage and permanently gain 10% Ultimate Damage Bonus (stacks up to 3 times).

name: Thundurus
desc: Each time the Pokemon uses a Basic Attack or Basic Skill, Ultimate damage increases by 20%, stacking up to 3 times and resetting after the Ultimate is cast.

name: Regieleki
desc: In battle, the Rage cap is reduced by 200.

name: Xurkitree
desc: Before battle ends, restore HP equal to 5% of Max HP for each Ultimate the Pokemon has used (up to 20%).

name: Miraidon
desc: Gain full Rage on entry. After every 2 active Ultimates, the Pokemon additionally casts 1 cost-free Ultimate; if that cost-free Ultimate defeats a unit, it gains 200 extra Rage.

name: Golem
desc: dual ATK increases by 15%.

name: Camerupt
desc: Max HP increases by 10%.

name: Sandslash
desc: Whenever the Pokemon loses HP, dual ATK increases by 5% (stacks up to 4 times).

name: Gigalith
desc: For every 1% Max HP the Pokemon loses, Damage Bonus increases by 3%.

name: Emboar
desc: For every 1% Max HP the Pokemon loses, dual ATK increases by 3%.

name: Klinklang
desc: For every 1% Max HP the Pokemon loses, dual DEF increases by 6%.

name: Dragonite
desc: The first time the Pokemon's current HP percentage falls below 50%, it gains a shield equal to 20% of Max HP for 2 rounds.

name: Sceptile
desc: On entering battle, gain a shield equal to 36% of missing HP for 2 rounds.

name: Garchomp
desc: After the Pokemon loses HP, restore 50 Rage (up to once per major round).

name: Regirock
desc: The first allied unit to take lethal damage survives with 1 HP.

name: Tyranitar
desc: For every cumulative 1% Max HP the Pokemon loses, dual ATK increases by 1% (up to 200%).

name: Zekrom
desc: The first time the Pokemon's HP falls below 50% and again below 20%, it additionally casts 1 cost-free Ultimate and gains 25% Life Steal, then deals extra true damage equal to 50% of its lost HP.

name: Froslass
desc: Control Rate increases by 20%.

name: Vanilluxe
desc: Enemy Control Immunity decreases by 20%.

name: Cubchoo
desc: Enemy targets under control effects take 10% more damage.

name: Torterra
desc: After an enemy target becomes controlled, the next attack it receives gains 100% Crit Rate.

name: Loudred
desc: When the Pokemon uses an Ultimate or Basic Skill on an enemy target under control effects, damage dealt increases by 30%.

name: Tapu Koko
desc: When attacking, there is a 30% chance to permanently increase Control Rate by 5% (stacks up to 5 times).

name: Raikou
desc: When the Pokemon uses a finishing move, there is a 30% chance to Stun the target for 1 round.

name: Alolan Ninetales
desc: When attacking, there is a 10% chance to inflict a random target with Stun, Sleep, Freeze, Silence, or Confusion for 1 round.

name: Articuno
desc: The first time an enemy target's current HP percentage falls below 70% or 30%, there is a 60% chance to inflict Freeze for 1 round.

name: Mega Abomasnow
desc: Each time the Pokemon controls an enemy, it restores 3% HP, up to 12% restored per action round.

name: Serperior
desc: When a control effect is applied to an enemy, deal true damage equal to 10% of the target's current HP (up to once per major round).

name: Darkrai
desc: At the start of each major round, there is a 30% chance to inflict the target with one of Stun, Sleep, Freeze, Silence, or Confusion (using the allied unit with the highest Control Rate for the calculation), and additionally deal true damage equal to 120% of the higher allied ATK value; damage increases by 10% for each control effect on the enemy, and on trigger the enemy's Control Immunity is reduced by 30%.

name: Blastoise
desc: Pokemon with a shield gain 16% Crit Rate.

name: Excadrill
desc: Pokemon with a shield gain 30% Crit Damage.

name: Tinkaton
desc: Pokemon with a shield gain 20% dual DEF.

name: Honedge
desc: Pokemon with a shield gain 15% Damage Reduction.

name: Aron
desc: After the Pokemon is attacked, it gains a shield equal to 18% of the HP lost from that attack.

name: Steelix
desc: On entering battle, the Pokemon gains a shield equal to 15% of Max HP.

name: Aggron
desc: After self attacks, there is a 60% chance to gain a shield equal to 12% of Max HP.

name: Metagross
desc: When self takes an active attack, deal rebound damage to the attacker equal to 30% of self's shield value (can Crit).

name: Cobalion
desc: Pokemon with a shield gain dual ATK equal to 40% of their shield value, capped at 120% of their initial dual ATK.

name: Stakataka
desc: Before battle ends, 20% of self's shield value is converted into HP recovery.

name: Registeel
desc: Attacks deal additional true damage equal to 30% of shield value (capped at 200% of the higher of self's dual ATK, and this damage can Crit).

name: Solgaleo
desc: At the end of each major round, inflict 【Rebound】 on all enemy units. The damage is true damage equal to the total amount of allied shields; this Rebound damage can Crit and inherits the highest allied Crit Rate.

name: Ludicolo
desc: After receiving healing, dual DEF increases by 20% for 2 rounds.

name: Chikorita
desc: After receiving healing, dual ATK increases by 20% for 2 rounds.

name: Starmie
desc: After the Pokemon provides healing, it restores HP equal to 10% of Max HP (triggers once per major round).

name: Slurpuff
desc: At the start of each major round, the Pokemon restores HP equal to 12% of Max HP.

name: Clefable
desc: Healing Received increases by 20%.

name: Arboliva
desc: While at full HP, damage taken is reduced by 30%.

name: Exeggutor
desc: After the Pokemon attacks, it deals true damage to the main target equal to 20% of its current HP.

name: Flapple
desc: When the Pokemon's HP falls below 30%, Max HP increases by 50% for 2 rounds (cooldown: 3 rounds).

name: Milotic
desc: When the Pokemon uses a Basic Attack or Basic Skill, it restores HP equal to 20% of the damage dealt by that attack.

name: Primarina
desc: Each major round, whenever an allied unit heals an allied target, the healing amount is recorded. After any allied target attacks, deal bonus true damage to the main target equal to 30% of the recorded healing.

name: Florges
desc: When casting an Ultimate, restore HP equal to 20% of Max HP and gain 50% Control Immunity for 1 round.

name: Shaymin
desc: At the end of each major round, restore 20% HP to allies; the more HP they have lost, the greater the healing. Also deal true damage to all enemy units equal to 50% of total allied healing this round, restore 200 Rage to self, and trigger 【Dispel I】.
